in_arabic.name: خاسفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المرأة التي تفضل الحق والصواب، اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل خسف، الذي يعني تفضيل الحق والعدل، ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف أولئك الذين يؤمنون بالله ورسله، ويتسمون بالصدق والعدل في كلامهم وأفعالهم، ولهذا الاسم أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية والتراث العربي

in_urdu.name: خاسفہ
in_urdu.meaning: حق و صواب کو ترجیح دینے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی gốc سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حق و صواب کو ترجیح دینے والی، اور قرآن پاک میں اس نام کا تذکرہ ہے جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے ان لوگوں کی توصیف کی ہے جو حق و صواب پر قائم رہتے ہیں، اور یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی بکثرت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: ख़ासिफ़ा

in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जो सत्य और न्याय को प्राथमिकता देती है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है, जहां यह नाम लड़कियों को दिया जाता है जो सत्य और न्याय के लिए जानी जाती हैं

data.cultural_impact: The name Khasifa holds great cultural significance in the Islamic world as it represents the idea ofrebirth, new beginnings, and growth. This name is believed to be of Arabic origin and is derived from the Arabic word "khassafa," which means "to bloom" or "to blossom." The name Khasifa signifies the beauty and resilience of nature, especially the blooming of flowers after a long winter. In Islamic culture, the flower serves as a powerful symbol of the inner growth and transformation of the human soul.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Khasifa signifies the potential for personal growth and transformation that exists within every individual. It is believed that just as a seed must go through the process of germination and growth to become a fully bloomed flower, every human being must go through the process of self-discovery and development to realize their full potential. This name also reminds us of the power of Allah (God) in bringing new life and renewing our commitment to the divine path. As individuals on this path, we are called to cultivate our inner gardens, tend to our spiritual needs, and allow ourselves to flourish and blossom in the light of Allah's guidance. May Allah help us all to experience the beautiful transformation that comes with spiritual growth and development, and may we continue to feel the joy and wonder of life's endless blooming.
